title.zh: 超级工程：大桥、铁路与管道

clips.send: Why send gas from west to east? West: big gas fields (Tarim, Qaidam, Ordos, Sichuan Basin) but fewer people and factories. East: crowded and industrial, needing huge amounts of energy. For the east: eases energy shortages, and burning gas instead of coal means cleaner air. For the west: turns natural resources into income and jobs, and builds new infrastructure.

clips.send: West–East Gas Pipeline, Line 2. Its gas comes mainly from Central Asia (Turkmenistan), through the Central Asia–China pipeline, entering China at Horgos. The main line ends at Guangzhou; branch lines reach Shanghai, Hong Kong and other cities. Designed to carry about 30 billion cubic meters of gas a year. Later 3rd and 4th lines were added; the Turpan–Zhongwei section of the 4th line (about 1,745 km) went into service in June 2025.

clips.send: Zhuhai Link Road. Part of this road runs in a tunnel under the busy Gongbei district of Zhuhai. Zhuhai is a Special Economic Zone in Guangdong Province, next door to Macao. The 55 km total counts this link road and the Hong Kong one too.

clips.send: West artificial island. About 100,000 square meters — roughly 14 football fields. Its walls are giant steel cylinders driven into the seabed and filled with sand. The road slopes down here into the tunnel.

clips.send: Zhuhai–Macao Port island. An island built in the sea for the border-check halls of Zhuhai and Macao. Cars need special permits to cross between the mainland, Macao and Hong Kong. From here the main sea crossing begins: about 29.6 km of bridge, islands and tunnel.

clips.send: Main bridge (22.9 km). Most of the bridge is long, low steel-box spans on concrete piers — cheap to build where only small boats pass. Three taller cable-stayed bridges leave gaps for ships. Their towers are shaped like a sail (Jiuzhou), dolphins (Jianghai) and a Chinese knot (Qingzhou). The bridge used about 420,000 tonnes of steel — often compared to 60 Eiffel Towers. It is designed to last 120 years and to stand up to strong typhoons and earthquakes.

clips.send: Undersea tunnel (6.7 km). The tunnel is about 6.7 km long; its immersed-tube part, about 5.7 km, was the longest immersed road tunnel in the world when built. 33 concrete sections, each 180 m long and about 80,000 tonnes, were sunk into a trench and joined underwater. The deepest point is more than 40 m below the sea surface. Above you, the biggest ships in the world can sail by — and no tower gets in the airport’s way.

clips.send: West–East Gas Pipeline, Line 1. Gas source: the Tarim Basin in southern Xinjiang. About 4,000 km (2,500 miles) long — nearly the drive from New York to Los Angeles (about 2,800 miles). It crosses the Gobi desert, the Loess Plateau, the Taihang Mountains, and runs under the Yellow River and the Yangtze River. Designed to carry about 12 billion cubic meters of gas a year at first.

clips.send: East artificial island. The road climbs out of the tunnel and back onto a bridge. The two islands are each about 100,000 square meters . From here the Hong Kong Link Road continues east.

clips.send: Hong Kong Link Road. A long viaduct, a short tunnel and a road along the edge of Hong Kong International Airport. The bridge drives on the right, like the mainland; Hong Kong drives on the left — traffic switches sides at the Hong Kong Port. Before the bridge, the trip from Hong Kong to Zhuhai took hours by road; now it can take under an hour.

clips.send: 珠海连接线。这段公路有一部分以隧道形式穿过珠海拱北城区。珠海是广东省的经济特区，紧邻澳门。大桥“全长约55千米”包括了珠海和香港两端的连接线。

clips.send: 主体桥梁（约22.9千米）。大部分是架在混凝土桥墩上的钢箱梁，造价较低，适合只有小船通过的水域。三座斜拉桥留出通航孔，主塔造型分别像风帆（九洲）、海豚（江海）和中国结（青州）。全桥用钢约42万吨，相当于60座埃菲尔铁塔。设计使用寿命120年，能抵御强台风和地震。

clips.send: 为什么要“西气东输”？西部：天然气资源丰富（塔里木、柴达木、鄂尔多斯、四川盆地等），但人口和工业较少。东部：人口稠密、经济发达，能源需求量大。对东部：缓解能源紧张，用天然气代替部分煤炭，改善大气质量。对西部：把资源优势转化为经济优势，增加收入和就业，带动基础设施建设。

clips.send: 海底沉管隧道（约6.7千米）。隧道全长约6.7千米，其中沉管段约5.7千米，建成时是世界上最长的公路沉管隧道。33节混凝土管节，标准管节长180米、重约8万吨，沉入海底基槽后在水下对接。最深处在海面以下40多米。头顶上，世界上最大的船也能通过；海面上也没有高塔妨碍机场航线。

clips.send: 香港连接线。由高架桥、一段隧道和沿机场边缘的道路组成。大桥主体靠右行驶；香港靠左行驶，车辆在香港口岸转换行车方向。大桥建成前，从香港坐车到珠海要好几个小时；现在一般不到一小时。
